title: Repair the patch-grid-to-image resolution budget
prompt: Return patch grid, decoder output size, target size, and missing spatial factor as exact rational numbers. The image dimensions must be patch-divisible. Example: 96/16 -> 6; two 2x stages -> 24; target 384 requires another 16x. This is a shape planner, not an image reconstruction model.
